official_definition: In game, the ability allows two Spirits to Contract Advent onto the same Contract Spirit, one on the left and one on the right, functioning like an Advent version of Imagine Brave.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Buddy] or [Buddy: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Buddy]", "give [Buddy]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
